fillInstructions.description: Behind the removed gray sign tile, the main bright-green creature body continues as a solid block. Fill the tile area (excluding the glyph holes owned by other objects) with the same flat green so the upper-left body mass remains continuous.
continueEdges: Continue the top green run horizontally across the removed area.
Continue the left-side green body edge straight through the removed area.
Continue the right-side green edge alignment so it stays flush with the existing body at x=150.
Continue the lower green boundary to keep a single connected upper-left green mass around this region.
fillInstructions.texture: Flat pixel fill (no gradient, no shading, no dithering).
